'''Sheepstongue root''' is an [[herbs|herb]] that can be found in the [[Two Rivers]] region. A mixture of sheepstongue root and [[rannel]] will perk a person up somewhat, but the significant property is its horrible and lasting taste. A village [[Wisdom]] such as [[Nynaeve]] may administer the concoction to someone who is claiming they are sick, moping, behaving "like a goose" and generally acting the fool.{{ref/book|2|8}}

According to [[Ailhuin Guenna|Mother Guenna]], an herbalist [[Wise Woman]], sheepstongue root is also helpful for eye pain.{{ref/book|3|48}}
